content.value: . An Otto cycle engine develops 50 kW at 150 rpm with 75 explosions per minute. The change of speed from the commencement to the end of power stroke must not exceed 0.5% of mean on either side. Find the mean diameter of the flywheel and a suitable rim cross section having width four times the depth so that the hoop stress does not exceed 4 MPa. Assume that flywheel stores 16/15 times the energy stored by the rim and thework done during power stroke is 1.40 times the work done during the cycle. Density of rim material is 7200 $k g / m ^ { 3 }$
